# Serenity UI

> Serenity UI (https://serenity-ui.com) is a free, open-source library of animated, interactive React components, blocks, and templates. Built with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and HTML5 Canvas.

## What is Serenity UI?
Serenity UI is an open-source collection of interactive, animated React components and blocks. It focuses on micro-interactions, 3D perspective animations, canvas effects, and tactile feedback built on top of Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion.

- **Author**: Ayushmaan Singh (@ayushmxxn)
- **Official Site**: https://serenity-ui.com
- **License**: MIT License (100% free for personal, client, and commercial projects)
- **Framework Support**: React 18 & 19, Next.js (App Router & Pages Router), Vite, Astro, Remix, Tailwind CSS
- **CLI Compatibility**: Compatible with the official shadcn CLI (`npx shadcn@latest add ayushmxxn/serenity-ui/<component-name>`)

## Core Categories & Components
1. **Interactive & 3D**:
   - Portfolio Book (`portfolio-book`): Multi-sheet realistic 3D book flip physics with handwritten typography.
   - Vintage Keyboard (`vintage-keyboard`): Retro typewriter typing experience with synthesized sound effects.
   - 3D Flip Card (`flip-card-3d`): Perspective hover tilt and dual-sided reveal.
   - Swipe Cards (`swipe-card`): Physics-driven gesture swipeable stack.
   - Carousel 360 (`carousel-360`): 360-degree cylinder 3D perspective slider.
2. **Buttons & CTAs**:
   - Flame Button (`flame-button`): GPU-accelerated canvas particle fire and dynamic glow shader.
3. **Navigation**:
   - Tubelight Navbar (`tubelight-navbar`): Floating Apple-style glass navbar with spring glow pill indicator.
4. **Social Proof & Testimonials**:
   - Brand Marquee (`brand-marquee`): Continuous 60fps logo ticker with alpha gradient masks.
   - Typewriter Testimonial (`typewriter-testimonial`): Animated character-by-character customer quote card.
   - Voice Testimonial (`testimonial`): Audio voice note waveform player with play/pause controls.
5. **Media & Galleries**:
   - 3D Image Carousel (`image-carousel`): Rotational depth perspective carousel.
   - Masonry Image Gallery (`image-gallery`): Smooth shared layout expandable lightbox gallery.

## Quick Start
```bash
# Add components directly via the shadcn CLI:
npx shadcn@latest add ayushmxxn/serenity-ui/carousel-360
npx shadcn@latest add ayushmxxn/serenity-ui/vintage-keyboard
npx shadcn@latest add ayushmxxn/serenity-ui/flame-button
npx shadcn@latest add ayushmxxn/serenity-ui/portfolio-book
npx shadcn@latest add ayushmxxn/serenity-ui/testimonial
```
